response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS average_maker_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate IS NULL, total_rebate DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: High-rate means a fee rate strictly greater than 0.0009.

alternatives.interpretation: Include fee records whose rate equals the cutoff.
